column1: # build/config/builders.tsv -- the build-host registry for second-builder
# verification (build/verify-reproducible.sh) and the per-image attestation
# (build/attest.sh).  One row per host that can build or verify an image.
# Columns (TAB):
#   builder_id   short stable id recorded in the attestation (builder.id)
#   host         DNS/IP to reach it (ssh jasonperlow@host)
#   arch         amd64 | arm64
#   cpu          the SoC/microarch (recorded as builder_cpu; proves CPU
#                independence when two DIFFERENT microarchitectures agree)
#   container    the imagebuild container the host must load, by digest
#   role         primary | second | pending
# OPERATOR DECISION D6 (2026-10-10): cixmini (.66, CIX Sky1 / Cortex-A720) is
# the SECOND arm64 builder ONCE its installation is stabilised (the operator
# reflashes it).  Until then the arm64 verification path is same-host-twice on
# ULTRA and the attestation records second_builder=pending(cixmini).
# A bit-identical rebuild across ULTRA (Apple Silicon / Asahi) and cixmini
# (CIX Sky1 / Cortex-A720) proves CPU-independence of the build (no
# -march=native, no CPU-feature-dependent codegen/paths).
